freePlan.limits: 15 Android and 15 iOS builds/month, low-priority build queue, updates to 1K MAUs, 25 projects, 45 min build timeout, 20 GiB storage, 100 GiB bandwidth.

keyLimits.en: 15 Android + 15 iOS builds/month, low-priority queue, updates to 1K MAUs, 25 projects, 20 GiB storage, 100 GiB bandwidth.
$45 of build credit included, high-priority queue, updates to 3K MAUs, 50 projects, 20 GiB storage, 100 GiB bandwidth.
$225 of build credit, 2 concurrent builds, 2h build timeout, updates to 50K MAUs, 100 projects, 1 TiB storage, 1 TiB bandwidth, priority support, SSO.
$1,000 build credit, 5 concurrent builds, updates to 1M+ MAUs, 300 projects, 10 TiB storage, 40 TiB bandwidth, SLAs and strategic support.

addOns.en: Extra Android build: $1 (medium) or $2 (large) per build beyond included credit.
Extra iOS build: $2 (medium) or $4 (large) per build beyond included credit.

cautions.en: Build costs are usage-based beyond the plan's included credit; heavy CI usage can exceed the flat monthly fee quickly.

capabilities.en: EAS Build, Submit and Update services for React Native app CI/CD.
Over-the-air (OTA) update delivery without app store review.
CI/CD Workflows automation and end-to-end code signing (Production plan and above).

limitations.en: Free plan build queue is low-priority, which can slow down CI turnaround.
Builds beyond the plan's included credit are billed per build, so costs scale with usage.

reason.en: EAS Build is Expo's own build service, often referenced separately as a competing/complementary product for React Native CI.
Mobile CI/CD platform competing directly with Expo's build and deploy services.
Common alternative/complement for mobile app backend and distribution.
Comparable developer platform philosophy (build, deploy, preview) applied to web instead of mobile.

unknowns: Exact overage pricing for storage/bandwidth beyond plan quotas not detailed on the pricing page.
